title: Agent-FLAN: Designing Data and Methods of Effective Agent Tuning for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Zehui Chen, Kuikun Liu, Qiuchen Wang, Wenwei Zhang, Jiangning Liu, Dahua Lin, Kai Chen, Feng Zhao
paper_type_zh: 代理训练数据重设计与工具使用监督研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究代理数据表达、能力混合权重、工具调用幻觉和负例监督的读者。
one_line: Agent-FLAN releases 24,703 redesigned agent conversations that separate reasoning, retrieval, arguments, format following, and tool-use negatives for SFT.
Agent-FLAN 把代理轨迹改写为按能力配比的自然对话，并加入不应调用工具的负例，共公开 24,703 条 SFT 记录。
why: It treats representation, capability balance, and non-action examples as data decisions and measures their effects separately from simply adding more trajectories.
inclusion_reason: Agent-FLAN openly releases a 24,703-record SFT mixture whose central contribution is the transformation, capability balancing, and negative supervision of serialized agent reasoning and tool traces.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing agent SFT corpora entangle ReAct/JSON formatting with reasoning, retrieval, and argument understanding, so a model can overfit the easy syntax while still failing to choose valid tools; they also omit negative cases that teach when not to call a tool.

Agent-FLAN redesigns inherited AgentInstruct and ToolBench traces into natural conversations, decomposes and reweights capability-specific targets, and adds explicit tool-use negatives. The public output is a 24,703-record, seven-split SFT mixture rather than only the Agent-H benchmark or a new agent runtime.

L4 facts: Primary source ACL Anthology; Findings of ACL 2024, 11-16 August 2024; decision boundary is redesigned trainable conversations rather than the Agent-H evaluation surface; atlas relevance is auditable capability balancing; data object is a conversation with rationale, tool choice, arguments, observations, and negative conditions; collected after proceedings, actual JSONL, Apache-2.0 terms, counts, and filters were verified.

既有代理 SFT 语料把 ReAct 或 JSON 格式与推理、检索和参数理解缠在一起，模型可能迅速记住容易的语法，却仍不会选择有效工具；这些语料还缺少“何时不应调用工具”的负例。

Agent-FLAN 把继承自 AgentInstruct 和 ToolBench 的轨迹改写为自然对话，拆分并重加权不同能力的训练目标，同时加入明确的工具使用负例。公开产物是含 24,703 条记录和七个分片的 SFT 混合，而不只是 Agent-H 评测集或新的代理运行时。

L4 事实：主来源为 ACL Anthology；正式发表于 Findings of ACL 2024，日期为 2024 年 8 月 11 至 16 日；边界是重新设计的可训练对话，而非 Agent-H 评测面；本图谱关注可审计的能力配比；数据对象包含推理、工具选择、参数、观察和负例条件；已核验正式论文、实际 JSONL、Apache-2.0 条款、规模和筛选规则后收录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Agent-FLAN changes agent tuning from imitating one rigid trace format to training a capability-balanced set of natural conversations plus explicit non-tool examples, so formatting cannot dominate the loss and the model learns both how and when to act. The closest comparison is AgentTuning; the feedback boundary combines inherited task correctness with constructed negative conditions, and the released training mixture, not Agent-H, defines the category.

Google Scholar citations: 150（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Agent-FLAN%3A+Designing+Data+and+Methods+of+Effective+Agent+Tuning+for+Large+Language+Models&author=Zehui+Chen&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: Agent-FLAN Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/internlm/Agent-FLAN Scale: 24,703 paper records; seven public files covering AgentInstruct and ToolBench transformations, including 22,867 ToolBench samples Record form: id plus conversation turns with role, content, and loss; content serializes state, Thought, Action, tool arguments or observations, final answers, and negative responses File / storage format: seven JSONL files, approximately 219 MB according to the official repository manifest Domains / languages: primarily English; web shopping, household worlds, web navigation, knowledge graphs, operating systems, databases, and APIs Construction and filtering: reformat ReAct/JSON as conversations, decompose four capabilities, reweight them, keep valid source traces, and add two tool-use negative families License / access constraints: Apache-2.0 for the official dataset and repository; inherited source-dataset terms still apply Intended use: supervised fine-tuning for general agents and tool-use models

Agent-FLAN 不再让模型模仿一种僵硬轨迹格式，而是训练按能力配比的自然对话与明确的“不调用工具”样本，从而避免格式损失占主导，并同时学习如何行动和何时行动。最接近的比较对象是 AgentTuning；反馈边界结合上游任务正确性与构造的负例条件，决定分类的是公开训练混合，而不是 Agent-H。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 — Audit and align source traces. Input: AgentInstruct and ToolBench records in ReAct, JSON, and tool-specific formats. Operation: Remove malformed records and few-shot demonstrations, require ToolBench FINAL ANSWER, remove DFSDT retry-preface samples, and convert fixed templates into multi-turn natural conversations. Output and transition: Clean aligned conversations enter capability decomposition. Check / stop rule: Reject records that violate Thought-Action-ActionInput or the stated ToolBench completion rules.

Step 2 — Decompose capabilities. Input: Each aligned reasoning and tool-use conversation. Operation: Derive separate training views for reasoning, tool retrieval, argument understanding, and instruction/format following, applying loss only to assistant clauses. Output and transition: Four capability-specific pools become candidates for mixture weighting. Check / stop rule: Preserve source semantics and required target fields; a view without its target capability is not admitted to that pool.

Step 3 — Balance data and add negatives. Input: Capability pools plus queries crossing whether tools are provided and whether users request tool use. Operation: Weight reasoning:retrieval:understanding at 1:0.25:0.75, add 2,000 format-following examples, and construct cases where tools are absent but requested or present but irrelevant. Output and transition: A 24,703-record mixture, defaulting to 10% ReAct and 90% conversation format, enters SFT. Check / stop rule: Negative targets must refuse nonexistent actions or answer normally without invoking an irrelevant tool; otherwise reject them.

Step 4 — Fine-tune and evaluate. Input: The weighted mixture and Llama-2 at 7B, 13B, or 70B. Operation: Run cosine-scheduled SFT, then evaluate held-in tasks, HotpotQA, SciWorld, WebArena, T-Eval, Agent-H, and general benchmarks. Output and transition: Agent-FLAN checkpoints plus evidence on agent performance, hallucination, and scaling. Check / stop rule: Compare both task score and Agent-H hallucination score; the paper does not specify one release-wide early-stopping threshold.

Reproducibility: pin the seven JSONL files, inherited source versions, transformation templates, loss masks, mixture weights, 10/90 format ratio, negative prompts, model scale, and Agent-H revision. Source-teacher cost, semantic decontamination, and one total training wall time are not disclosed.

步骤 1——审计并对齐上游轨迹。 输入：采用 ReAct、JSON 和工具专用格式的 AgentInstruct 与 ToolBench 记录。 操作：删除格式错误记录和少样例示范；ToolBench 必须含最终答案，并删除带 DFSDT 重试前缀的样本；再把固定模板转换为多轮自然对话。 输出并进入下一步：清洗和对齐后的对话进入能力拆分阶段。 检查与停止规则：不符合思考、动作、动作参数结构或 ToolBench 完成规则的记录直接拒绝。

步骤 2——拆分能力。 输入：每条对齐后的推理和工具使用对话。 操作：分别派生推理、工具检索、参数理解和指令或格式遵循的训练视图，并只在助手轮次计算损失。 输出并进入下一步：四个能力专用样本池成为混合配比的候选。 检查与停止规则：保留上游语义和必需目标字段；不包含对应目标能力的视图不能进入该样本池。

步骤 3——平衡数据并加入负例。 输入：能力样本池，以及交叉组合“是否提供工具”和“用户是否请求工具”的查询。 操作：把推理、检索、理解按 1 比 0.25 比 0.75 加权，加入 2,000 条格式遵循样本，并构造未提供却请求工具或提供了无关工具的情形。 输出并进入下一步：形成 24,703 条记录的混合，默认由 10% ReAct 和 90% 对话格式组成，进入 SFT。 检查与停止规则：负例目标必须拒绝不存在的动作，或在工具无关时正常回答而不调用工具，否则删除。

步骤 4——微调并评测。 输入：加权混合，以及 7B、13B 或 70B 的 Llama-2。 操作：采用余弦调度做 SFT，再评测同域任务、HotpotQA、SciWorld、WebArena、T-Eval、Agent-H 和通用基准。 输出并进入下一步：得到 Agent-FLAN 检查点，以及代理表现、幻觉和规模效应的证据。 检查与停止规则：同时比较任务分数和 Agent-H 幻觉分数；论文没有给出一个覆盖全部发布内容的早停阈值。

可复现性：需要固定七个 JSONL 文件、继承的上游版本、转换模板、损失掩码、混合权重、10 比 90 的格式比例、负例提示、模型规模和 Agent-H 修订版。论文未披露上游教师成本、语义去污染结果和统一训练耗时。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main comparison uses Llama2-7B and the same held-in/held-out evaluation suite for a reimplemented AgentTuning and Agent-FLAN. Overall score rises from 38.2 to 41.7; T-Eval rises from 61.8 to 66.0 and WebArena from 2.71 to 4.68 (Table 1), while the training-token count falls from the 37.3M all-aligned mixture to 18.1M after capability weighting (Table 2). This supports the redesigned mixture under this backbone, but format conversion and changed data weights move together.

The negative-sample ablation holds the Agent-FLAN setup and removes its negative examples. Agent-H falls from 89.1 to 84.5 without negatives, with ReAct-format hallucination increasing from 9.9 to 15.6, while T-Eval stays 66.0 versus 66.3 (Table 3). This isolates the value of explicit non-tool cases for hallucination behavior, but Agent-H checks output mode and does not establish semantic safety for arbitrary tools.

主比较使用 Llama2-7B，并让重实现的 AgentTuning 与 Agent-FLAN 在同一套同域和未见任务上评测。总分从 38.2 升到 41.7，T-Eval 从 61.8 升到 66.0，WebArena 从 2.71 升到 4.68，见表 1；能力加权后，训练词元量又从全部对齐混合的 37.3M 降到 18.1M，见表 2。这支持该主干上的数据重设计，但格式转换和权重变化仍同时发生。

负例消融保持 Agent-FLAN 配置，只移除负例。没有负例时，Agent-H 从 89.1 降到 84.5，ReAct 格式幻觉从 9.9 升到 15.6，而 T-Eval 基本不变，为 66.0 对 66.3，见表 3。这较好地隔离了明确“不调用工具”样本的作用，但 Agent-H 主要检查输出模式，不能证明任意工具上的语义安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html: AgentTuning mixes complete agent trajectories with general dialogue but keeps much of the original ReAct/JSON coupling and offers little supervision for inappropriate tool calls. Agent-FLAN changes the data decision itself: it converts traces into conversational views, decomposes four capabilities, weights them by learning behavior, and adds negative non-action targets. The direction signal is that representation and missing counterexamples can matter more than simply scaling trajectory count. The source tasks, SFT objective, ReAct traces, and ToolBench APIs are inherited rather than new.

AgentTuning 把完整代理轨迹与通用对话混合，但仍保留较多 ReAct 或 JSON 与能力目标的耦合，也很少监督不恰当的工具调用。Agent-FLAN 真正改变的是数据决策：把轨迹转换为对话视图，拆分四类能力，按学习表现加权，并加入“不行动”的负例目标。它给出的方向信号是，数据表达方式和缺失的反例可能比单纯增加轨迹数量更重要。上游任务、SFT 目标、ReAct 轨迹和 ToolBench 接口都是继承组件，并非新贡献。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Author-stated limitation: training and validation cover only part of the agent landscape, so the balance learned on seven source families may not transfer to new action spaces. Reuse should add held-out tool schemas and environments before fixing the mixture weights.
  1. Author-stated limitation: only roughly 20,000 valid ToolBench samples, about ten percent of that source, are used for quality. Reuse should report API-category coverage and compare against a larger, equally filtered subset.
  1. Curator audit risk: negative templates can teach superficial cues for whether tools exist, while inherited traces retain teacher errors and source terms. Reuse should adversarially paraphrase negative cases and audit record-level lineage rather than trusting Agent-H alone.

1. 作者明确指出：训练与验证只覆盖代理领域的一部分，因此在七类来源上学到的配比未必能迁移到新的动作空间。复用时应先加入留出的工具模式和新环境，再固定混合权重。
  1. 作者明确指出：为保证质量，只使用约两万条有效 ToolBench 样本，约为该来源的十分之一。复用时应报告接口类别覆盖率，并与更大且采用同等过滤的子集比较。
  1. 策展审计风险：负例模板可能让模型依靠“是否出现工具”的表面线索，而继承轨迹仍带有教师错误和上游条款。复用时应对负例做对抗式改写，并审计逐条血缘，而不能只信 Agent-H。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For a tool-use SFT builder, reuse the seven splits to compare rigid ReAct targets, natural conversations, CoT, and explicit no-tool examples under one base model. The output is a controlled mixture report; success requires both task metrics and a hallucination-mode check, and the recipe is unsuitable when tool availability cannot be represented.
  • For a data curator, reproduce capability-specific loss curves and re-estimate reasoning/retrieval/understanding weights on the target model. The output is a model-specific sampling plan; do not copy the 1:0.25:0.75 weights across model families without remeasurement.

• 对工具使用 SFT 构建者，可用七个分片在同一基础模型上比较僵硬 ReAct 目标、自然对话、思维链和明确的不调用工具样本。输出是受控的数据混合报告；成功标准应同时包含任务指标和幻觉模式检查，若无法表示工具可用性，就不适合直接采用该配方。
  • 对数据策展者，可在目标模型上复现各能力损失曲线，并重新估计推理、检索和理解的权重。输出是模型专用采样方案；没有重新测量时，不应把 1 比 0.25 比 0.75 的权重直接复制到其它模型家族。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Agent-FLAN addresses format overfitting and inappropriate tool calls by redesigning 24,703 inherited demonstrations rather than collecting another undifferentiated corpus.
  • Method handle: conversational alignment, four-way capability decomposition, weighted sampling, and negative supervision are the key decisions; the last one governs when not to act.
  • Data handle: seven Apache-2.0 JSONL splits expose id and role/content/loss conversations spanning ReAct, CoT, transformed, and negative examples.
  • Evidence anchor: overall held-in/held-out score rises from reimplemented AgentTuning's 38.2 to 41.7, while negatives lift Agent-H from 84.5 to 89.1 without improving T-Eval.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for auditing agent-data representation and mixture design; remeasure loss curves and paraphrase negative cases before transferring weights.

• 一句话定位：Agent-FLAN 通过重设计 24,703 条继承示范来解决格式过拟合和不恰当工具调用，而不是再收集一份未区分能力的大语料。
  • 方法抓手：对话化对齐、四类能力拆分、加权采样和负例监督是关键决策，其中负例决定模型何时不应行动。
  • 数据抓手：七个 Apache-2.0 的 JSONL 分片公开编号及角色、内容、损失对话，覆盖 ReAct、思维链、转换样本和负例。
  • 证据锚点：同域与未见任务总分从重实现 AgentTuning 的 38.2 升到 41.7；负例在几乎不改变 T-Eval 时，把 Agent-H 从 84.5 提高到 89.1。
  • 复用决定：适合审计代理数据表达与混合设计；迁移权重前必须重新测损失曲线，并改写负例以排除模板捷径。
